args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the release of v2.3.1, with a production error rate of ~18%. Resolution actions taken: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent version previously healthy in production. Post-rollback, the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%. Requires further engineering investigation into the root cause of the v2.3.1 deployment failure before re-attempting release.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate across all production regions.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent version that was healthy in production — in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, the service is healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which has paged on-call. The incident describes the failure symptoms and the rollback actions taken.

Note: v2.3.1 remains unreleased/rolled back pending investigation into the root cause of its health check failures.
